🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Did You Know your internet data travels through walls like a ghost? 👻

💡 Your Wi-Fi uses invisible radio waves, a type of electromagnetic energy, that easily pass through walls and furniture, connecting your devices throughout your home.
